content:
oncall-lee: alert: embedder eu-west1 5xx jump to ~5%. small KV cache index bug identified in v2.1.3. quick fix built as v2.1.4-hotfix. requesting expedited deploy, region-only, skip 10m canary.

deploy-bot: HOTFIX REQUEST: service=embedder region=eu-west1 image=embedder:v2.1.4-hotfix trigger=alert-embed-5xx

sara: How confident are tests? any risk to global traffic?

oncall-lee: unit + sanity tests pass. issue localized to eu-west1 node set. patch is one-line index fix.

maya: Security scan clean. no creds or perms changed. +1 sec.

loren: SRE +1 if rollback gates set and smoke script runs. Add auto-cutback if node restarts >2 in 3m.

pm-raj: Product OK; please include short release blurb for status page update.

eng-lead-janet: I approve skipping canary for eu-west1 only. Conditions: explicit rollback criteria, smoke checks, support notified, 15m post-check.

oncall-lee: Rollback criteria: sustained 5xx >1% for 3m OR p95 +300ms for 5m OR logs contain "kv-index-fail" correlated with new image.

deploy-bot: APPROVALS RECEIVED (4). Executing deploy: skip_canary=true rollout=region-eu-west1

deploy-bot: Step 1 drain old pods -> OK
deploy-bot: Step 2 apply image -> OK
deploy-bot: Step 3 run smoke `./tools/embedder-quick-check --region eu-west1`

oncall-lee: smoke x8 queries PASS, no 5xx. logs show kv index fix.

deploy-bot: Step 4 finalize -> 100% traffic. Telemetry: 5xx back to baseline, p95 stable.

oncall-lee: Support notified, status updated (INC-9001). scheduling +15m verification.

loren: leaving follow-up to check cross-region spillover and run KV prefix invalidation tomorrow.

eng-lead-janet: Incident mitigated. RCA to follow. good job team.

deploy-bot: AUTO: rollback command `/deploy rollback embedder eu-west1 embedder:v2.1.3` if needed.

sara: nice work everyone :rocket:
